title: GeoNames cities × NASA POWER climate

about.name: GeoNames
about.quote: The GeoNames geographical database covers all countries and contains over eleven million placenames that are available for download free of charge.
about.label: geonames.org

about.name: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER)
about.quote: NASA POWER provides solar and meteorological data from satellite observations and models to help worldwide users respond to challenges and societal needs.
about.label: NASA Langley

here: Here: 300 cities from GeoNames cities15000 (the most populous, a few per country, plus capitals and far-flung islands and polar towns), as their position on the globe (A) and as NASA POWER’s 2001–2025 monthly climate at that spot: 12 mean temperatures in °C and 12 rainfalls as log(1 + mm/day), each of the 24 columns rescaled to mean 0 and spread 1 (B).

geonames.text: GeoNames (2026). cities15000: all cities with a population > 15000 or capitals. geonames.org. CC BY 4.0.

nasa_power.text: NASA Langley Research Center (2026). Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) Climatology API v2.10.1, MERRA-2 monthly climatology 2001–2025, accessed 2026-10-14. Funded through the NASA Earth Science Division.
